name: Thriller AI Dance
blurb: One photo in: you doing the zombie dance on a foggy street full of jack-o'-lanterns.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep them exactly as photographed: same face, hair, skin tone, body shape and outfit. They dance alone on a night sidewalk under the street lamps; low fog rolls across the path and a row of glowing jack-o'-lanterns lines the grass on both sides. They do the Thriller zombie dance: arms swung out together to one side with a deep lean, stiff claw hands raised, sharp shoulder shrugs, a slow head roll, then shuffling steps forward and a stomp, all locked to the beat. If the photo is a close selfie, they first step back from the camera so the whole body is in frame. One continuous take, no cuts, full body in frame, vertical 9:16. Spooky synth-funk beat with a deep bassline in the audio, no vocals. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
